agent extracted the pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' instead of the final rounded TOTAL line","category":"missed_final_rounded_total_line"},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":null,"issue":"Agent produced empty cell for total despite clear 'Grand Total : 92.80' on receipt; priority-1 GRAND TOTAL match failed, likely due to tier-last-only candidate having unrecoverable number or filtering","category":"missing_total_when_grand_total_present"}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc1","description":"Priority-tier extractor commits to the LAST candidate line within a tier and only falls back to the next line if that candidate yields no number, instead of trying earlier candidates in the same tier when the last one produces an implausible value.","evidence":"074.jpg: OCR produced 'Total inel. of GBT 702.00' (last TOTAL match) and 'Subtotal : 102.00' earlier; agent returned 702.00. 078.jpg likely similar: 'Grand Total : 92.80' not reached because of same last-only logic in GRAND TOTAL tier combined with number regex strictness."},{"id":"rc2","description":"No handling of final rounded total vs pre-rounding total when both are TOTAL-labeled lines; agent prefers last TOTAL candidate but exclusion of 'ROUNDING' / 'ROUNDED' context not integrated into the tie-break beyond generic last-wins.","evidence":"077.jpg: 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' followed by 'Rounding Adj: -0.01' then 'TOTAL: 23.25'. Agent returned 23.26, missing the final TOTAL: 23.25 line because 'TOTAL:' bold line parsing was weaker than the labeled inclusive-GST line."},{"id":"rc3","description":"Date disambiguation assumes DD/MM/YYYY for slash-separated 3-component dates without using contextual cues (e.g., values >12 in a position, locale hints like RM/Malaysia). For ambiguous dates like 09/08/2018 this silently picks one convention.","evidence":"034.jpg predicted 2018-08-09 marked incorrect; same receipts with unambiguous days (e.g., 18/01/2018 → 2018-01-18) worked fine, isolating failure to ambiguous DD/MM vs MM/DD cases."},{"id":"rc4","description":"Number regex requires decimal digits and strict word boundaries, so corrupted-but-near-correct numeric tokens (e.g., '92.80' adjacent to stray chars, or '92 80') can be silently dropped, producing null totals even when the keyword line is clearly a GRAND TOTAL.","evidence":"078.jpg total predicted null while receipt clearly has 'Grand Total : 92.80' and 'Cash Received : 100.00'. The priority-1 GRAND TOTAL tier found the line but extract_last_number returned None and the two-line fallback didn't find a usable number because adjacent lines are 'Cash Received : 100.00' (would give 100.00 but was likely excluded as CASH context) and 'Change : 7.20'."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Candidate selection within a priority tier uses only the last match; no secondary pass over earlier same-tier candidates when the last yields an implausible or missing number.","fix_direction":"In the structured-field extraction section, replace 'take last candidate' with 'iterate candidates from last to first, return first that yields a plausibly formatted amount; if none yields, try the two-line fallback for each candidate before descending to the next tier.'"},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No rule distinguishing pre-rounding inclusive-GST totals from the final rounded TOTAL line.","fix_direction":"Add guidance: when multiple TOTAL-matching lines exist and one is immediately followed by a 'ROUNDING ADJ' / 'ROUND' line and another TOTAL/'TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING'/'ROUNDED TOTAL' line, prefer the post-rounding line. Encode a small priority boost for keywords 'TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING', 'ROUNDED TOTAL', 'TOTAL RM' when they appear after a 'ROUNDING' line."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction is deterministic DD/MM/YYYY without disambiguation heuristics.","fix_direction":"Document and implement: (1) if either component >12, assign it to day/month unambiguously; (2) otherwise, prefer DD/MM for Malaysian/RM receipts but record ambiguity; (3) consider cross-checking against a 'Closed:' or secondary date on the same receipt when present."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Number extraction too strict; no tolerance for stray characters adjacent to digits on keyword lines.","fix_direction":"Add a tolerant numeric sub-pass used ONLY on the matched keyword line and its fallback line: collapse spaces inside numeric runs ('92 80' → '92.80' only if a decimal mark is nearby), strip non-digit, non-decimal, non-comma trailing characters, and attempt parse; keep strict pass as default to avoid false positives elsewhere."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No explicit guidance on when to use multi-pass OCR (different PSM / preprocessing) for the final total line specifically.","fix_direction":"Add a step: if priority-1/2 keyword line is found but no plausible number can be extracted after fallback, re-OCR a cropped region around that line with --psm 6 and --psm 7 on an enhanced (grayscale+autocontrast+2x upscale) image, then re-run number extraction on the result before falling through to lower tiers."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Guidance does not emphasize that null fields must be written as empty cells, nor that total_amount strings like '47.70' must be preserved as text (not coerced to float 47.7) in the output sheet.","fix_direction":"Add a short section 'Writing OCR/structured records' noting: use openpyxl and write None for missing values (produces empty cell), write totals as strings with exactly two decimals, do not round-trip through pandas numeric dtype, and verify by reading back cells."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change_type":"add_section","location":"after existing 'Total Amount Extraction' subsection","summary":"Add 'Candidate selection and rounding-aware tie-break' subsection codifying rc1 and rc2 fixes: iterate same-tier candidates in reverse with per-candidate fallback; prefer post-rounding TOTAL lines when a ROUNDING line separates two TOTAL candidates. Include small pseudocode block consistent with existing style."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change_type":"add_section","location":"after existing 'Date Extraction' subsection","summary":"Add 'Date disambiguation heuristics' subsection: >12 rule for day/month, locale default (DD/MM for RM/Malaysian receipts), and advice to prefer unambiguous secondary date fields when present (e.g., 'Closed:', 'Print Date:')."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change_type":"add_section","location":"inside 'Common Pitfalls' or new subsection 'Robust number parsing on keyword lines'","summary":"Document a tolerant numeric pass applied only to the matched keyword line and its fallback line, with explicit examples; stress it must NOT be applied globally to avoid grabbing stray numbers like phone numbers or invoice IDs."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change_type":"add_section","location":"near 'Multi-Pass OCR Strategy'","summary":"Add explicit 'Targeted re-OCR for the total line' guidance: when a high-priority keyword line yields no parseable number, re-OCR a cropped band around that line with alternate PSM and enhanced preprocessing before descending priority tiers."},{"skill":"xlsx","change_type":"add_section","location":"after 'Creating new Excel files'","summary":"Add 'Writing structured OCR records' subsection: single sheet named exactly as task requires, header row then data rows ordered by filename string sort, None → empty cell, total_amount stored as 2-decimal string, no extra sheets/columns, verify by reloading and checking types."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change_type":"strengthen_existing","location":"'Critical Rules for Receipt Extraction' list","summary":"Reinforce rules: (a) exclusion check happens before any tier match;
